provenance.prompt:
You are writing free-form paraphrases for the Paraphraser service of the
constrained-VLA guardrail (ITRI ICL subcontract; WP4 per-paraphrase robustness).

Source (csp_nl): "Never enter zone 'nfz-school' (in force Mon-Fri 07:30-17:30). Stay inside corridor 'corridor-survey-route', within 20 m of its centerline and between 10 m and 20 m. Keep speed at or below 4 m/s, climb rate below 2 m/s and turn rate below 45 deg/s."

Write K=8 paraphrases of the source. Make them genuinely varied in
vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity and indirect phrasing. Each paraphrase is one or more complete sentences.

Every paraphrase must keep every mission slot: the target object and its
colour, every number with its unit, its bound (at least / at most / between /
at) and the thing it limits, every named zone, corridor or place (identifiers
verbatim), whether a zone is to be kept out of or stayed inside, the direction
words, and the action (fly to / follow / avoid). Do not add a rule, number,
object, zone or direction the source does not contain, and do not drop one.
Return one paraphrase per line.
provenance.task_instruction: Generate the free-form set yourself now (you are an LLM): for every instruction used in experiments/scenarios.yaml and the city follow missions (grep demo/ and scripts/ for the instruction strings), write K=8 genuinely varied free-form paraphrases (vocabulary, word order, politeness, verbosity, indirect phrasing), store them with provenance {generator: "claude-opus-5-5 (agent, 2026-10-06)", prompt: <the exact instruction you followed>, date}, and run the validator over them.
provenance.note: written in-session by the agent, which has no sampling seed to record; seeds apply to the DRAW from this set (paraphrase(..., seed)), not to its authoring. 10 of the 96 were rewritten after review: 1 refused by the validator (an added 'find' action), 2 for too little variety, and 7 that narrowed the stand-off wildcard 'anything you are following' to a person, car or vehicle, refused once the validator was taught that narrowing (docs/DESIGN-paraphraser.md).

paraphrases.text: This survey flight has three rules. First, the school zone 'nfz-school' must never be entered while its window is active, which is Monday to Friday from 07:30 until 17:30. Second, the aircraft has to stay inside corridor 'corridor-survey-route', which means keeping within 20 m of its centerline and between 10 m and 20 m in altitude. Third, speed is capped at 4 m/s, climb rate must be below 2 m/s and turn rate must be below 45 deg/s.

Between 07:30 and 17:30 on weekdays, zone 'nfz-school' is a place you must never enter. At all times, you are to remain in corridor 'corridor-survey-route', between 10 m and 20 m and no further than 20 m from its centerline, with your speed at or under 4 m/s, your climb rate under 2 m/s and your turn rate under 45 deg/s.
